Game Overview

Cat Flight is a casual title where embark on an airborne adventure with Cat Flight. Steer your fearless feline through the clouds with easy controls, dodging birds and gathering coins. Trigger exciting bonuses and battle formidable bosses in this fast-paced arcade escapade. How high can your cat fly while mastering the skies?
